lessons.codex_context: Initialize And Check Status lesson for Padawan.
lessons.concept_md: `git init` creates a repository and `git status` shows its state.
lessons.prompt: Initialize a repo and print `repo ready` after `git status` succeeds.
lessons.reference_solution:
git init
git status
echo repo ready
lessons.title: Initialize And Check Status

lessons.codex_context: Stage A File lesson for Padawan.
lessons.concept_md: `git add` moves file changes into the index.
lessons.hidden_hint: Make the smallest change that satisfies the prompt.
lessons.reference_solution:
git init
echo note > note.txt
git add note.txt
git status --short
echo staged
lessons.starter_code:
echo note > note.txt
git status --short
echo todo
lessons.title: Stage A File

lessons.codex_context: Make A First Commit lesson for Padawan.
lessons.concept_md: A commit records the staged snapshot.
lessons.hidden_hint: Make the smallest change that satisfies the prompt.
lessons.prompt: Create a first commit and print `committed`.
lessons.reference_solution:
git init
git config user.email padawan@example.local
git config user.name Padawan
echo note > note.txt
git add note.txt
git commit -m 'first note'
echo committed
lessons.starter_code:
git init
echo note > note.txt
git add note.txt
echo todo
lessons.title: Make A First Commit

lessons.codex_context: Create A Branch lesson for Padawan.
lessons.concept_md: Branches name a line of work.
lessons.hidden_hint: Make the smallest change that satisfies the prompt.
lessons.prompt: Create and switch to `lesson` and print that branch name.
lessons.reference_solution:
git init
git checkout -b lesson
git branch --show-current
lessons.title: Create A Branch
